opening.argument: The speaker presents Mirror Trading International as a hands-free way to grow Bitcoin, saying, "I'm growing my Bitcoin just by allowing MTI mirror trading international to trade for me so it's a passive income hands-free." He describes members receiving a percentage of trading results credited to their balance and recommends joining through a link. The opportunity also includes optional referral commissions: viewers may "refer and build a network and earn commission from your network building, from your referrals." Although he concedes that poor trading or losses may mean "less or no payouts made," that qualification does not remove the passive-income promotion or the referral mechanism supporting the opportunity.
